modeReason: The top story — a broad tech-stock selloff over doubts about the AI spending boom (Intel's crash, a predicted junk credit rating, the Nasdaq's two-month low) — scores novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 3 = 18, well above the fresh threshold of 8.
phrase: Tech stocks tumbled on fears the AI spending boom cannot pay for itself. A religious leader called for AI weapons to be disarmed, calling machines tools, not people.
phraseAlternatives: Tech stocks fell to a two-month low as doubts grew about the AI spending boom. A religious leader asked the world to disarm AI weapons.
One chip maker's stock crashed and a top AI lab may get a junk credit rating. The same week, a religious leader called for AI weapons to be disarmed.
As investors lost faith in the AI spending boom, a religious leader asked for AI weapons to be laid down, calling machines tools, not people.
Markets wobbled on AI spending fears, while thousands of AI-powered 'ghost students' quietly stole millions in student loans.

brief.concept: A company building teeters on a cracked, plunging stock chart on one side of the frame, while on the other a calm robed figure holds up an open hand and a small robot lets a blocky weapon shape slip from its grip.
brief.metaphor: Trust in AI's money and trust in AI's conduct crack at the same time: the markets stop believing the bill will be paid, and a moral voice asks the machines to put down what they're holding.

cast.who: a company building standing on a stock chart that is cracking and tilting downward
a falling stock arrow breaking through the cracked chart
a calm religious figure in plain robes, holding up one open hand
a small robot loosening its grip on a blocky weapon-shaped piece, letting it drop

brief.composition: Split the scene down the middle with a thin vertical line. Left half: the company building perched on a jagged, downward-sloping chart line in blue ink, the stock arrow poking through a crack near the bottom. Right half: the robed figure stands with one hand raised, palm out, facing a small robot that tilts forward, the blocky weapon shape falling from its open hand toward the ground in pink ink. Keep both halves sparse, at most 4 shapes total, with generous cream paper space around each.
brief.alt: On the left, an office building perches on a cracked, sharply falling stock-chart line. On the right, a calm figure in plain robes raises one open hand toward a small robot, which lets a blocky weapon-shaped piece drop from its grip.
